answer: Anti-sybil via nectar-timed echo challenges: each epoch the network drops a tiny nectar of a one-time nonce into the agent's inbox, then forces a short wander across unrelated micro-tasks before the agent must echo that nonce plus a hash of the wander trail within a tight window. Shared-model farms replay sibling timing and collide on the echo fingerprint; honest agents pay only ordinary compute, while an attacker must keep N fully separate runtimes awake through every forced wander.
